notes.title: Tea Garden Simulator: Now Localized in Simplified Chinese!
notes.notes:
Hello Tea Garden Enthusiasts!

We are thrilled to announce that Tea Garden Simulator is now fully localized in Simplified Chinese! 🌿✨ This significant update opens the doors for our Chinese-speaking players to immerse themselves in the serene and intricate world of tea cultivation, processing, and culture.

[b]A Tribute to Chinese Tea Farmers[/b]
The journey of Tea Garden Simulator has been deeply inspired by the rich heritage and profound knowledge of Chinese tea farmers. Their dedication to the craft, meticulous techniques, and unwavering passion for tea have been a beacon of inspiration for our development team. We owe a tremendous debt of gratitude to these remarkable individuals whose traditions and expertise have shaped the game’s authenticity and depth.

[b]What’s New in This Update?[/b]
[b]Simplified Chinese Localization:[/b] Every menu, dialogue, and piece of content is now available in Simplified Chinese, ensuring a seamless and enjoyable experience for our Chinese-speaking community.
[b]Cultural Enhancements:[/b] We’ve added new cultural elements and details inspired by Chinese tea traditions to enrich your gameplay experience.
[b]Bug Fixes and Improvements:[/b] As always, we’ve been working hard to address any bugs and improve the overall performance of the game.

Join Us in Celebrating This Milestone
To celebrate this update, we invite all players to participate in our special in-game events and challenges that highlight the art and beauty of Chinese tea culture. Share your experiences, screenshots, and stories with us on our community forums and social media channels. We look forward to seeing how you cultivate your tea gardens and honor the legacy of tea farming.

Thank you for your continued support and passion for Tea Garden Simulator. We hope this new localization brings joy and a deeper connection to the world of tea to our Chinese players.

Also, we are working on Slovak Localization. Try that out too.

Happy Gardening!

Warm regards,

notes.title: UX and Automation Upgrade + Russian Localization
notes.notes:
Hello, tea heads!

We have been working on Ver 1.1 of Tea Garden Simulator, and some major changes are coming. And we think that you are going to love it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38855962/0d4277687563f8fc0d87c76f8fdd633a3d865d4e.png[/img]

[olist]
[*] We have now streamlined the production flow from farm to store. With automation, you can now connect your tea storages on farms to factory machines, and after processing the pipeline, they can be linked to a warehouse, where they will be stored.
[*] Additionally, in your store, you can now link that warehouse slot to a product. When the product is out of stock, it will be sourced from the warehouse. Thus, the pipeline from farm to store can be fully automated. Provided the quality is at par. You can now setup multiple production pipelines and see them work uninterruptebly. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38855962/88562756565ce98be90960e6ced8c60fe1dc00a8.png[/img]
[*] To add usability, we have added shortcuts to start and stop factory or field work using (SPACE) and (1, 2 & 3) for various speeds.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38855962/019cc1f29993ed821d6ba849eae3ee4465ee09f2.png[/img]
[*] To move the camera in the game, you can now right-click and drag in addition to the WSAD buttons.
[*] Some parts of the story in the campaign have been updated.
[*] The bankruptcy was creating a lot of friction, coupled with a bug in the land sale. We fixed the bug and updated the bankruptcy to continue with an additional $10000’ rather than exiting and restarting.
[*] Music can now be turned off in settings.
[*] Esc to close the tabs.
[*] The factory speed will not reset on proceeding to the next day.
[*] For Russian players, we have added the Russian language, which is in Beta. While playing, if you find errors in the Russian version,. Please comment on this document.
[url=https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/11bl652cE5EfFl6gLOHD-NJDPJDzJBv2GqOHTwIOZnm0/edit?usp=sharing]Russsian Loc Link[/url]
[*] Various bug fixes.
[/olist]

Keep playing Tea Garden Simulator with a cup of tea!

notes.title: Update 9/22
notes.notes:
Hello, teaheads,

We are happy to implement more features in this update.

1. The change of seasons now affects the color palette of the entire level. In addition to that, the fog and cloud cover and rain fx are also added.

2. We are introducing a bunch of BRAND NEW tea processing equipment which can be helpful in preparing more variations of tea.

a) Hand rolling - This manual process is extremely helpful for subtly damaging your tea and processing it again for more flavors. Make sure you keep an eye on the chemical charts for better understanding.

b) Hand Tossing - This is even subtler than hand rolling. This tradition of bruising tea is quite common among oolong producers. This method is for further tweaking your tea flavors.

c) Bruising Machine - This tumbling machine is predominant in oolong factories. They are trying to mimic hand shaking or tossing via a machine. But can it really replace manual bruising? What do you think?

d) Sha Qing Wok - This is the staple equipment for Chinese producers. It's still an irreplaceable part of tea production, especially Puerh. A hard labor-intensive process, but with its benefits.

e) Automated Sha Qing Machine - This is the automated version of sha qing wok. Fast, efficient. But, will it give the same quality as manual sha qing? You have to experiment with it to find out. 

f) Steaming Machine - This is also a very popular option. Especially among Japanese and Indian green tea producers. But you have to tweak your pipeline a bit to accommodate this.

g) Ball Rolling Machine - This is popular among Oolong producers. Especially who like to preserve the volatiles. 

h) Rack Drying Machine - No fuss, efficient and effective. But they give a slightly different result than the traditional roasting machine.

i) Charcoal Roasting - This is quite a specialty tea equipment. We are really unsure about its effectiveness apart from the nuances it brings in flavors. We tried our best to implement it. Let us know the results. 

There are also numerous small improvements and bug fixes apart from these. But we don't want to bore you with that. Go ahead and play with these new toys and let us know what you think.

Cheers

notes.title: Huge Update - Complete rewrite
notes.notes:
This is the upgrade that we've been promising for the better part of a year.

The entire game has been completely redone from the ground up. Only the visual materials were reused in this project. The reason behind this is that the game has shifted from being a mid-core simulation game to a hard-core simulation game. Because the prior version and the architecture were unable to support the elaborate and complicated gameplay we were aiming for, we had to abandon them.

However, it took significantly longer than we had anticipated. And here's what came out of it. The game does not even come close to the previous version in terms of quality.

These are some of the most important aspects of what you can expect.

The simulation engine was completely rewritten to simulate over 46 different flavour compounds derived from a total of ten precursor chemicals. (There were just two in the prior edition.)

The development of precursor chemicals is influenced by the time of year. Cultivation stress is being simulated.

Apart from soil and other elements, the land now has an impact on the precursor growth of the tea plant, which was formerly influenced by them.

The presence of amino acids in the chloroplasts was used to simulate the presence of clones/cultivar genes in the cells.

In this version of the simulation model, numerous loops are combined to get a more complex yet consistent output.

The machines have a more objective impact on the simulation and do so through a defined set of settings.

These are only a few of the numerous features of this new version.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38855962/a63efe06024d42b3a6d808672a98d6d1df3d6fd6.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38855962/7ae1bd9a93c58d3106625e6e2aa0261bfaa8f348.png[/img]


You are more than welcome to experiment with this new build. Your feedback will only help the sim engine to improve in the future. This build is still in the process of being tested. As a result, there may be bugs. Please let us know about it in our discord group.

Hopefully, this new build will prove to be well worth the wait.

Cheers.

notes.title: Two leaves and a bud - origins
notes.notes:
Two leaves and a bud is a tea farm and factory management game. Produce a variety of tea. Craft your own processing technique, expand and manage your Tea Estate. You'll also have to deal with factors such as pests, weather, and labor management, which can either make or break your business.

The game is a joint effort by [url=www.chengmari.com]Chengmari Tea Estate[/url] and [url=www.flyingrobotstudios.com]Flying Robot Studios[/url].  Sharing their common passion for true tea, they bring out the secrets of producing the finest quality from the closet of the Tea Masters to the gamers of Steam.

All true tea comes from the Camellia sinensis plant. White, Green, Oolong, Yellow, Black, and Fermented teas all come from the varieties and cultivars of the Camellia sinensis plant, and the type, style, quality, and price of tea is determined by the skillful processing methods used on the plucked leaves. 

We hope to infuse that passion for craftsmanship through this game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38855962/c5eb3204d24787862f8f4d5e6103a789a82b2b10.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38855962/79b7f1832d6b08b90b4a6576b864a1d136f2f9a8.png[/img]

Although this game plays like a management game, the core of the mechanics is a simulation of the tea chemistry. Which makes this an open-ended sandbox. The player is only limited by his imagination in this game. 

We have also published a Demo with limited features. You can get a taste of what the game will actually play like. 

[url=https://discord.com/channels/762266639093727242/762266639093727244][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38855962/96146db9b4158fc2350acab6ce91380bd5f09662.png[/img][/url]
